chapter.heading: The Lord the Avenger of His PeopleA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Plead my
cause, O Lord, with those who strive with me;Fight against those who fight against me. [Prov. 22:1] [Eccl. 4:2]

Take hold
of shield and buckler,And stand up for my help.

Also draw
out the spear,And stop those who pursue me.Say to my soul,“I am your salvation.” [[2 Cor. 7:10]]

Let those
be put to shame and brought to dishonorWho seek after my life;Let those be turned back and brought to confusionWho plot my hurt.

Let them
be like chaff before the wind,And let the angel of the Lord chase them. [Ps. 141:5; [Prov. 13:18; 15:31,]

Let their
way be dark and slippery,And let the angel of the Lord pursue them.

For without
cause they have hidden their net for me in a pit,Which they have dug without cause for my life. [Ex. 23:8; Deut. 16:19; [Prov. 17:8,]

Let destruction
come upon him unexpectedly,And let his net that he has hidden catch himself;Into that very destruction let him fall. [Prov. 14:29; Gal. 5:22; Eph. 4:2]

And my
soul shall be joyful in the Lord;It shall rejoice in His salvation. [Prov. 14:17; James 1:19]

All my
bones shall say,“Lord, who is like You,Delivering the poor from him who is too strong for him,Yes, the poor and the needy from him who plunders him?”

Fierce witnesses
rise up;They ask me things that I do not know. [Eccl. 11:7]

They reward
me evil for good,To the sorrow of my soul. [Prov. 3:18 6 A] [Eccl. 9:18]

But as
for me, when they were sick,My clothing was sackcloth;I humbled myself with fasting;And my prayer would return to my own heart. [Job 12:14]

I paced
about as though he were my friend or brother;I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns for his mother. [Deut. 28:47]

With ungodly
mockers at feastsThey gnashed at me with their teeth.

Lord, how
long will You look on?Rescue me from their destructions,My precious life from the lions. [Job 15:32; Ps.]

I will
give You thanks in the great assembly;I will praise You among many people. [Eccl. 3:14;]

Let them
not rejoice over me who are wrongfully my enemies;Nor let them wink with the eye who hate me without a cause. [Prov. 21:22; Eccl. 9:13-18]

For they
do not speak peace,But they devise deceitful mattersAgainst the quiet ones in the land. [1 Kin. 8:46; 2 Chr. 6:36; Prov. 20:9; Rom. 3:23; 1 John 1:8]

They also
opened their mouth wide against me,And said, “Aha, aha!Our eyes have seen it.”

This You
have seen, O Lord;Do not keep silence.O Lord, do not be far from me.

Stir up
Yourself, and awake to my vindication,To my cause, my God and my Lord. [Rom. 1:22]

Vindicate me,
O Lord my God, according to Your righteousness;And let them not rejoice over me. [Job 28:12; 1 Tim. 6:16 x Rom.]

Let them
not say in their hearts, “Ah, so we would have it!”Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.” [Eccl. 1:17]

Let them
be ashamed and brought to mutual confusionWho rejoice at my hurt;Let them be clothed with shame and dishonorWho exalt themselves against me. [Prov. 5:3,]

Let them
shout for joy and be glad,Who favor my righteous cause;And let them say continually,“Let the Lord be magnified,Who has pleasure in the prosperity of His servant.” [Eccl. 1:1,]

And my
tongue shall speak of Your righteousnessAnd of Your praise all the day long. [Job 33:23]
